title: Session database operations
responsibility: Provide database methods to create, find and revoke authentication sessions.

inputs.name: d1CredentialStores.db
inputs.description: D1-compatible database handle; queries run only when the returned store methods are called.

inputs.name: d1CredentialStores.records
inputs.description: Validator used to turn stored database rows into typed records.

outputs.name: d1CredentialStores
outputs.description: Session store: create inserts a record, find returns a validated row or null, and revoke marks the named session and its direct child sessions revoked when not already revoked.
